name: Andrea de Adamich
features: dark hair, moustache, thoughtful face, tall lean build
bio: The Trieste law graduate who was Alfa Romeo's man in everything from the GTA to the 33/3 and the Alfa-engined McLaren and March Formula One cars. Shared the T33/2 at Daytona and the Nurburgring and won Sebring outright in the 33/3 in 1971. Later a television commentator for a generation of Italians.
